items.definition:
afternoon nap
In many hot countries, people take a siesta in the afternoon.

instrument showing speed
The speedometer showed that he was driving too fast.

the practice of not eating meat
She adopted vegetarianism for health reasons.

a device or object that warms something
She bought a new food warmer for the party.

a person who keeps bees
The beekeeper harvested honey from the hives.

a meat-based sauce for pasta, originating from Bologna, Italy
She made a delicious spaghetti bolognese for dinner.

a candy or sauce made with brown sugar and butter
She loves the rich flavor of butterscotch pudding.

a dish in which small pieces of food are dipped into a hot sauce or melted cheese
We had cheese fondue for dinner last night.

a type of flowering plant
She planted bright red geraniums in the window box.

one of the two upright posts with a crossbar that form a goal in sports
The striker hit the ball directly into the goalpost.

easily combustible material used to start a fire
We gathered some dry leaves and small twigs for kindling.

a primate native to Madagascar
The ring-tailed lemur is easily recognizable by its striped tail.

a person who happens to be going past something
A passerby stopped to help the injured man on the street.

a page or set of pages of information produced by a computer printer
Please give me a printout of that report by the end of the day.

a large, powerful breed of dog
The Rottweiler guarded the property fiercely.

a deep, continuous, resonant sound
We heard the distant rumbling of thunder.

shredded cabbage salad
I'd like a side of coleslaw with my meal.

a type of open pastry with a sweet or savory filling
She baked a delicious apple tarte for dessert.

a type of freshwater fish
We had smoked whitefish for dinner.

a sturdy table at which manual work is done
He spent hours at his workbench, crafting wooden toys.

a public display of aerobatics and aircraft
We went to the airshow and saw many impressive planes.

An online forum for real-time text communication.
She spent hours talking to friends in the online chatroom.

Utensils for cooking.
The kitchen store has a wide selection of cookware.

a unit of currency in several Middle Eastern and North African countries
He exchanged his dollars for Jordanian dinars.

a large, oval, spiny tropical fruit with a strong, distinctive odor
The durian is known for its strong smell and unique taste.

a first-year university student (UK)
The university welcomed its new batch of freshers.

unpleasantness; unkindness
The nastiness of his comments shocked everyone.

a small dog breed
My neighbor has a fluffy Pomeranian.

a device or substance that removes impurities
We bought an air purifier for the bedroom.

the ground at the bottom of a river
The ancient artifacts were found in the riverbed.

a person who snowboards
The snowboarder performed an impressive trick.

a tool for tightening or loosening nuts and bolts
He used a spanner to fix the bicycle.

an event where food or drink is sampled
We went to a wine tasting last weekend.

vocabulary (informal)
I need to learn more vocab for the test.

the part of the week during which one works
The standard workweek is five days long.

a board placed behind the basket in basketball
He shot the ball off the backboard and into the hoop.

an area next to a barn
The chickens were pecking for grain in the barnyard.

a market in a Middle Eastern country
We bought souvenirs at the local bazar.

A rich, sweet bread.
She ordered a coffee and a warm brioche for breakfast.

Squid, especially when cooked and eaten.
We ordered fried calamari as an appetizer.

A camisole; a woman's loose-fitting undergarment for the upper body.
She wore a silk cami under her blazer.

A small rodent native to the Andes, known for its soft fur.
The chinchilla is a popular pet due to its gentle nature and soft fur.

a short glass tube with a rubber bulb at one end, used to measure out drops of liquid
She used a dropper to add the medicine to the water.

water that has overflowed from a river or other body of water
The floodwater receded slowly after the storm.

a thick, sugary paste used for decorating cakes
The cake was covered in smooth white fondant.

sewing, embroidery, or other work done with a needle
She spent her evenings doing intricate needlework.

a candy made from sugar or honey, nuts, and egg white
The chocolate bar had a delicious nougat center.

clothes worn over other clothes, especially outdoors
She packed warm outerwear for the winter trip.

a large, showy flower
The garden was full of beautiful pink peonies.

a building where electricity is generated
The city's electricity comes from a large powerplant.

an armchair that can be tilted back
He relaxed in his favorite recliner after a long day.

a dessert made of toasted marshmallow, chocolate, and graham crackers
We made s'mores over the campfire.

a broad-brimmed hat, especially one of straw, worn in Mexico and the southwestern US
He wore a large sombrero to protect himself from the sun.

a device for spraying liquid
She used a garden sprayer to water the plants.

an item of clothing worn under outer clothes
She chose comfortable undergarments for the long journey.

a boat or ship
Various types of watercraft were moored in the harbor.

a scented lotion applied to the face after shaving
He splashed some aftershave on his face.

A liquid added to water to lower its freezing point.
You should check your car's antifreeze before winter.

A person who rides a bicycle.
The bicyclist wore a helmet for safety.

The action of dismissing an employee from a job
The company announced the firing of several senior executives.

A mattress, typically cotton-filled, that can be rolled up or folded
We bought a new futon for the guest room.

a male godchild
My godson is celebrating his fifth birthday next week.

a light on the front of a vehicle or worn on the head
He put on his headlamp before entering the dark cave.

the process of folding and sewing the edge of cloth
She spent the afternoon doing the hemming on her new curtains.
